name: Warehouse Aisle 01
note: A pedestrian walks through a forklift-only cross-aisle. Tripod shot with no floor lines to measure, so the calibration is deliberately unverified: it fails the 2 px quality gate and the camera runs in zone-only mode. Zone rules fire; distance and speed rules stay off rather than trusting estimated meters.

assumptions.camera_height_m: 0.80 m, from two estimates at t=8 s. (a) Pallet front faces at row y=728 (188 px below the horizon) span ~270 px; for 1.2 m EUR pallets h = 1.2*188/270 = 0.84 m. (b) The worker (feet y=860, head y=135) at an assumed 1.75-1.80 m gives h = 0.77-0.79 m.
assumptions.focal_length_px: 1550 px (~63 deg horizontal FOV), a typical 35 mm-equivalent lens. Nothing in the frame measures depth, so this is a plain assumption; it only affects distances along the camera axis.
assumptions.depth_vanishing_point_px: Assumed at the principal point: level camera (vertical rack uprights stay vertical), looking straight across the aisle.

rules.description: Pedestrian inside a forklift-only aisle beyond the dwell limit.
